Answer: C
Reason: The chest radiographs and CT scan demonstrate an ill-defined area of consolidation in the left lower lobe (specifically the apical segment) without associated hilar or mediastinal lymphadenopathy. This pattern, particularly when unresponsive to antibiotics, is characteristic of Bronchiolitis Obliterans Organizing Pneumonia (BOOP), also known as Cryptogenic Organizing Pneumonia (COP).
